verdict.rationale: Kino is an agent-integrated video editor, so shipping an installable agent skill collection is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only a desktop-app MCP server and cloud agents installing Kino itself. Neither is a skill collection installed with a single documented command that becomes active in the next session.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session
